propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map call search_issues without paging, so they only cover the first 50 issues of any project.
The default max_results=50 causes silent truncation with no error raised, letting the pass report success while data is incomplete.
Truncated link data causes spurious link-creation mutations and prevents detecting link removals; comment sync is silently incomplete.
The fix extracts one truncation-safe pager _paged_search that advances by len(batch) and stops only on an empty page, since Jira DC caps maxResults so a short page does not prove exhaustion.
All three whole-project readers (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map, get_parent_map) are routed through the shared pager to prevent a fourth hand-rolled unpaginated loop.
get_parent_map's existing behavior and degradation contract (WARNING plus empty map on failure) must remain unchanged after routing through the helper.
